origin.description: Computes a weighted MAD for each row of a numeric matrix.
origin.usage:
rowWeightedMads(x, w = NULL, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  constant = 1.4826, center = NULL, ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric matrix. Each row is passed to weightedMad.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: A vector of weights, one for each column. NULL gives every column equal weight.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: constant
arguments.text: A numeric scale factor of length one, cf. stats::mad. The default is 1.4826.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional numeric vector of length nrow(x). A scalar is defunct when rows is NULL.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The matrix is subset with R's [ rules, then each remaining row is passed to weightedMad. w, when given, is subset by cols and shared by every row. center is checked against the original number of rows and then subset by rows.
origin.value: A numeric vector with one value per selected row.

translation.description: Computes a weighted MAD for each row of a numeric matrix.
translation.usage:
rowWeightedMads(x, w=None, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False,
  constant=1.4826, center=None, use_names=True, *, low=False, high=False)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A one-dimensional vector is rejected.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Weights for the columns, shared by every row. None uses stats::mad on each row. After cols is applied, the length must match the number of selected columns.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zero is dropped, negatives exclude, and a positive index past the end is an error. A missing index inserts a missing row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column. The same index subsets w when w is given.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: Passed to weightedMad for each row. This is na.rm in R.

arguments.name: constant
arguments.text: One numeric scale factor. The default is 1.4826. A vector is an error, including on the unweighted path.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: One center per original row, then subset by rows. None estimates each row separately. A single value is an error: that use is defunct in matrixStats 1.5.0.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain array; names are not attached.

arguments.name: low
arguments.text: Passed to each unweighted mad. Ignored when w is given.

arguments.name: high
arguments.text: Passed to each unweighted mad. Ignored when w is given.

translation.details: Rows are evaluated independently by weightedMad. A matrix is never read in storage order: axis 0 is the row margin. An empty selection returns a length-zero vector. A row with no columns is missing.
translation.value: A float64 vector with one value per selected row.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.weightedmad import rowWeightedMads

x = np.array([[1, 4, 7, 10], [2, 5, 8, 11], [3, 6, 9, 12]], dtype=float)
rowWeightedMads(x)
